Check what a dash-cam kit records and how it is powered

Front-only and multi-channel kits need different checks

Confirm the number of cameras supplied, not just supported. Rear-camera cable length, connector type and mounting position matter in a long vehicle. Resolution may differ when several cameras record together, so compare the actual recording modes. Check whether a compatible high-endurance memory card is included and which capacity and formatting instructions the manufacturer specifies.

Parking recording is a separate installation question

Do not assume a USB-powered camera will record with the ignition off. Check the required hardwire kit, battery-protection settings and installation instructions. For reviewing footage, compare screen, app and card-reader access rather than treating Wi-Fi as cloud storage. Date, time and loop-recording setup deserve an arrival check before you depend on the camera for a journey.
